name: walk
about: Good Egg, star 1, in real time: the stick tilted forward for two seconds moves Mario at least 3 m from his start. The run's diagnostics reach the game (frame-times lines), and the pacing line (one each 10 s of play) names the game and render threads' CPU time.

expect.log: \[pacing\] [0-9]+ frames in [0-9.]+ ms \([0-9.]+ ms a frame\), [0-9]+ on the display's vsync
; game CPU [0-9.]+ ms average, [0-9.]+ ms longest \(frame [0-9]+\)
; render CPU [0-9.]+ ms average, [0-9.]+ ms longest \(frame [0-9]+\)
